text: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟。王毅说，在两国元首领航掌舵下，双方正在推动构建中美建设性战略稳定关系。事实证明，改善发展中美关系，在相互尊重基础上和平共处，进而合作共赢，符合两国人民根本利益，符合国际社会共同期待。同时，中美关系仍面临各种风险挑战。双方应把两国元首达成的重要共识落到实处，聚焦积极议程，妥善管控分歧，为两国高层交往排除干扰、克服障碍，推动中美关系朝着稳定、健康、可持续的方向发展。
text_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns in Beijing. Wang Yi said that under the stewardship of the two heads of state, both sides are working to build a constructive and strategically stable China-US relationship. Facts show that improving and developing bilateral ties, coexisting peacefully on the basis of mutual respect, and then achieving win-win cooperation serves the fundamental interests of both peoples and meets the common expectations of the international community. Meanwhile, the relationship still faces various risks and challenges. Both sides should implement the important consensus reached by the heads of state, focus on a positive agenda, properly manage differences, remove interference and overcome obstacles for high-level exchanges, and steer the relationship toward stable, healthy, and sustainable development.
